items.word: Er wusste es nicht, und ich ebenso wenig.
items.definition:
ebenso wenig
just as little;no more than
He didn't know it, and neither did I.

fristlos
without notice;summarily
He was dismissed without notice.

schleppend
sluggishly
The negotiations proceeded sluggishly.

items.word: Unglücklicherweise regnete es den ganzen Tag.
items.definition:
unglücklicherweise
unfortunately
Unfortunately, it rained all day.

vorschnell
rashly;prematurely
One should not decide rashly.

items.word: Anbei finden Sie die gewünschten Unterlagen.
items.definition:
anbei
attached;enclosed
Attached you will find the requested documents.

geradewegs
straight;directly
He went straight home.

vonstatten
(to take place;to proceed)
The preparations proceeded quickly.

items.word: Mancherorts gibt es noch unberührte Natur.
items.definition:
mancherorts
in some places;here and there
In some places, there is still untouched nature.

ringsum
all around;roundabout
All around, everything was quiet.

items.word: Schlimmstenfalls müssen wir den Plan ändern.
items.definition:
schlimmstenfalls
in the worst case
In the worst case, we will have to change the plan.

items.word: Das hätte man schon im Vorhinein wissen müssen.
items.definition:
im Vorhinein
beforehand
One should have known that beforehand.

erfreulicherweise
fortunately
Fortunately, the weather held up.

items.word: Das können wir ja andermal besprechen.
items.definition:
andermal
another time
We can discuss that another time.

jahrhundertelang
for centuries
This tradition has existed for centuries.

tonnenweise
tons of;in tons
They cleared tons of snow.

items.word: Er sah sie letztmals vor zehn Jahren.
items.definition:
letztmals
for the last time
He saw her for the last time ten years ago.

nebenberuflich
part-time (as a side job)
He works part-time as a musician.

items.word: Ironischerweise regnete es an unserem sonnigen Urlaubstag.
items.definition:
ironischerweise
ironically
Ironically, it rained on our sunny vacation day.

stufenweise
gradually;step by step
The changes will be introduced gradually.

phasenweise
in phases;periodically
The project was implemented in phases.

kommentarlos
without comment;uncommented
He left the room without comment.

drein
in a particular way (with schauen or aussehen)
He looked sad.

items.word: Er hatte keine Zeit; konsequenterweise konnte er nicht kommen.
items.definition:
konsequenterweise
consequently;logically
He had no time; consequently, he couldn't come.
